ipos.about: Incorporated on September 29, 2005, Monomark Engineering (India) Limited is engaged in providing Industrial Operations and Maintenance (“O&M”) services, Metal Fabrication solutions and Industrial Project Execution services to industrial clients across sectors such as metals, cement, ports and engineering/OEMs. The Company’s business is organised into three segments: Industrial O&M Services, Metal Fabrication Solutions and Industrial Project Execution Services. Its O&M services include production support, plant operations, preventive and breakdown maintenance, equipment monitoring and technical support. Its metal fabrication activities involve manufacturing customised sheet metal components and structural products based on client specifications and engineering drawings. Under its project execution segment, the Company undertakes engineering, procurement and construction (“EPC”) contracts, as well as on-site fabrication, erection, installation and commissioning (“FEIC”) assignments involving heavy machinery, piping, structural steel and industrial equipment.

ipos.about: Incorporated on June 23, 2004 , Matangi Rubber Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of tyres, tyre flaps, tyre tubes and rubber compounds. It primarily caters to the two-wheeler and three-wheeler tyre segments, while its tyre flaps and tubes are used in commercial vehicles such as trucks, buses and heavy utility vehicles. The Company operates through three business models: manufacturing and selling, contract manufacturing and job work services. Under its manufacturing and selling model, it manufactures and sells tyre tubes under its own brand. Its contract manufacturing activities primarily involve producing customised tyre flaps bearing clients’ logos, while its job work services involve processing raw materials supplied by customers into tyres, tyre flaps and tubes in return for conversion charges. The Company also manufactures rubber compounds used in the production of other rubber products.
